headword: {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}
gloss: the four cardinal directions; all directions

definitions.gloss: east, west, south, and north; the four cardinal directions
definitions.explanation: The four main compass directions considered as a set. Literally lists them in the Japanese order: east, west, south, north.
Used figuratively to mean 'in every direction' or 'all over the place.'

examples.japanese: {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}を{覚|おぼ}えましょう。
examples.english: Let's learn the four cardinal directions.

examples.japanese: コンパスで{東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the cardinal directions with a compass.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}では{方角|ほうがく}を{東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}の{順|じゅん}で{言|い}うのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: In Japanese, it is common to list the directions in the order east, west, south, north.

examples.japanese: {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}どこへでも{行|い}ける。
examples.english: You can go anywhere in any direction.

examples.japanese: {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}から{人|ひと}が{集|あつ}まってきた。
{彼|かれ}は{東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}を{旅|たび}して{回|まわ}り、{各地|かくち}の{文化|ぶんか}を{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: He traveled in all directions and learned about the cultures of various regions.

notes:
The order of directions in Japanese is {東|ひがし} (east), {西|にし} (west), {南|みなみ} (south), {北|きた} (north) — different from the English convention of north, south, east, west. This four-character compound uses the on'yomi readings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}の{方角|ほうがく}: the four cardinal directions
- {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread in all directions
- {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}がわからない: to not know which way is which

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {方角|ほうがく}: direction, compass point — the general concept of direction
- {四方|しほう}: four directions, all sides — similar meaning but less specific to compass directions
- {方位|ほうい}: compass bearing — more technical, used with compasses and navigation
